benefit_text: The scheme gives training in Designated Trades and Optional Trades. Government pays 25% of stipend up to Rs.1,500 per month through bank transfer. Minimum stipend is Rs.5,000 to Rs.9,000 per month based on schooling and certificates.
who_can_apply: Apprentices must be 14 to 35 years old. Age is 18 years for hazardous trades. Candidates need Aadhaar number and e-KYC on the apprenticeship portal.
documents: Aadhaar Card is needed for registration. Documents required as per selected trade are needed.
how_to_apply: Candidates go to the official Apprenticeship Portal and choose register as candidate. Candidates enter mobile number and email ID with Aadhaar number. Candidates complete e-KYC and mobile OTP authentication.
